title: Sharp linear stability and the absence of enhanced dissipation for Kolmogorov flow in the 2D Navier--Stokes equations with horizontal dissipation
summary: We study the linearized dynamics of the Kolmogorov flow $U^{(0)}=(a\sin x_2,0)$ for the two-dimensional incompressible Navier--Stokes equations with horizontal dissipation $ν\partial_1^2$. Unlike the fully dissipative case, this anisotropic system admits $U^{(0)}$ as an exact unforced steady state. On each horizontal Fourier mode $k$, the dissipation reduces to the scalar $-νk^2$ and commutes with the advection, so that the linearized semigroup factors exactly into $e^{-νk^2t}$ times the inviscid Euler group.
